The kids fell in love with the shipbuilding system from Traveller so I decided to bind them a copy of the 2022 version of High Guard. I think it’s my best #TTRPG #bookbinding to date. 

Decided to sew the cover to reduce strain on the end papers a bit and make it easier to glue them on straight.

images.alt: The cover, showing the black star-spangled bookcloth used for the cover.
The spine, showing the twin tapes with French links overtop them, a pair of Coptic link stitching in the middle, and how the sewing on the cover links to the spine stitching.
An interior shot, showing the blue endpapers and the title sheet. It is the 2022 edition of the Traveler High Guard manual released by Mongoose.
An interior shot, showing ship stat blocks two of the spacecraft that come with the book, a military gig and a ship’s launch.

.
I've wanted to design a vehicle for a pretty long time (and... watching Mutafukaz, playing Cyberpunk was really inspiring) and I finally did! (I really love vespa in fact. I love "vintage" vehicles in general).
.
